free_tier.stated: free subdomains under 5 public domains including ae.kg, delegated by NS records to the user's own DNS provider; invite-based registration, a maximum of 3 domains per user

per_object_cap.stated: a maximum of 3 domains per user in total: at most 1 under ae.kg and 2 others, or 3 other than ae.kg

retention.stated: no expiry or renewal term is stated on the pages read; the introduction says there are free renewals and that availability is not guaranteed

egress.terms: no query cap published; the registry holds only the delegation

interface_detail: a web dashboard at registry.kevsrv.me; the registration form asks for the nameservers of the user's DNS provider, and the registry offers NS management only; no API was read
tooling: the registry dashboard, then a DNS provider of the user's choice that can host the zone
chaining: the delegation can point at an external DNS provider such as Hurricane Electric or deSEC or ClouDNS, which makes the name a zone of the registrant's; ae.kg is on the Public Suffix List, so each name has its own TLS limit

limits.value: registration is limited by an invite code, and a new domain needs approval by registry staff after a written reason of at least 50 words
a maximum of 3 domains per user in total, at most 1 of them under ae.kg

binding_note: the zone is the registrant's through delegation

identity_cost.detail: an invite code and an account through a login method the page does not name; a written reason of at least 50 words for each domain; the login methods are unverified because the sign-in page was not read

reliability_note: a domain may be suspended without prior notice, registration is invite-only, and the operator states one account per person
confidence_note: the introduction and the get-started guide were read and quoted; the sign-in page, the terms and the management guide were not read; the ae.kg listing is an entry of the captured Public Suffix List, and the TLS statement is an inference from it and the Let's Encrypt registered-domain rule
